candidates.claim: OT-facing port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/6 is configured as an access port assigned to VLAN 30 (the CORP zone VLAN) instead of VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Move GigabitEthernet1/0/6 back to access VLAN 10, or if it must serve CORP, relocate it to a CORP-side switch rather than the OT switch.

candidates.claim: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/6 on sw-ot-01 deviates from the approved baseline: switchport access vlan changed from 10 to 30.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile with the baseline by restoring access VLAN 10 on GigabitEthernet1/0/6, or record an approved change for this port.
